entries: Second-stage joint-noise test; per-receiver white model, detection limits, independent-data research

Owner instruction 'Proceed with steps 1-2. Do some research on the best sources for independent data for J2043 and J1453.' Family gained per-receiver white scales and noise floors. On simulated J1453+1902 data with joint chain draws: scales only 27.77 (set by chain); scales and floors 23.04 (set by strong_steep; chain 1% threshold 22.10; 4 of 1024 chain validation nulls cross; all validation false-alarm rates at or below 0.5%). Half-detection amplitude 4-17% above the consumed run's curve. Detection limits (50% and 95% amplitude, minimum mass) tabulated for J1939, J1453, J1359, J0908, J1048, J1327. Independent data: only FAST/CPTA DR1 is precise enough and its TOAs must be requested.

No observed residuals read; nothing frozen or run. Consumed outcomes and grades unchanged. Joint chain generator and per-receiver white family now required for future second-stage tests where a released chain exists (rule item 6). J2043 not recalibrated. No limits for J2043, J1752, J1012, J1738 (no curve). Source research not re-verified; no data request made.
